
```jsx
import { CxNavbar } from '@chassis-ui/react'
// or
import CxNavbar from '@chassis-ui/react/src/react/src/components/navbar/CxNavbar'
```

| Property | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **className** | A string of all className you want applied to the component. | `string` \| `undefined` | - |
| **colorScheme** | Sets if the context of text should be colored for a light or dark dark background. | `'dark'` \| `'light'` \| `undefined` | - |
| **component** | Component used for the root node. Either a string to use a HTML element or a component. | `string` \| `ComponentClass<any, any>` \| `FunctionComponent<any>` \| `undefined` | nav |
| **container** | Defines optional container wrapping children elements. | `boolean` \| `'small'` \| `'medium'` \| `'large'` \| `'xlarge'` \| `'2xlarge'` \| `'fluid'` \| `undefined` | - |
| **context** | Sets the context context of the component to one of Bootstrap React’s themed colors. | `'primary'` \| `'secondary'` \| `'success'` \| `'danger'` \| `'warning'` \| `'info'` \| `'dark'` \| `'light'` \| `string` | - |
| **expand** | Defines the responsive breakpoint to determine when content collapses. | `boolean` \| `'small'` \| `'medium'` \| `'large'` \| `'xlarge'` \| `'2xlarge'` \| `undefined` | - |
| **placement** | Place component in non-static positions. | `'fixed-top'` \| `'fixed-bottom'` \| `'sticky-top'` \| `undefined` | - |
